title: Robust Linear Dueling Bandits with Post-serving Context under Unknown Delays and Adversarial Corruptions

split.decision: Online Figure 2(b): T=2000, d=10, e=20, K=10, sinusoidal map, Gaussian delays N(100,100^2), C=25. Public validation master 20261030: 10 episodes; hidden test master from secrets: 10 disjoint episodes, one group. No offline training. The original 10 fixed seeds are retained only for archival metric verification; secret holdout replaces public evaluation seeds to prevent leakage. Separate instance/noise/algorithm streams. Protocol v2 preserves every generated episode but hides all test seeds and future state in the private labels directory. Candidate policies run in per-episode sandbox workers; trusted RPC enforces causal access and counts.

baseline.paper_ref: Figure 2(b); operational reproduction 9364.691823109459. New hidden episodes and separated RNG streams; see operator notes.
baseline.timing_scope: legacy protocol estimates retained for operational budgeting; not a measured v2 reference

conversion.reason: Experiment-preserving private-policy-v2 repair verified on one original validation episode; full reference and full throughput were not requested.

leakage_remediation.verification_scope: One original validation episode with all 2000 rounds, original RCDP-UCB updates and per-call equality against the archived causal environment; final allocation extension checked separately by tiny dispatch.

experiment_preservation.prediction_timing_scope: Original input parsing + all causal workers and model reads + original complete CSV serialization. Artifact export/preparation/cleanup and original scoring remain separately timed. All episodes share one deadline.
experiment_preservation.allowed_method_scope: Method, features, model, loss, hyperparameters and training procedure remain editable under the original causal and fresh-state rules. Optional episode_cpus=1..8 enables intra-episode parallelism; requests >1 run episodes sequentially to preserve the archived concurrent-worker numerical-thread restriction.

allowed_changes: Any dueling algorithm, internal preference/utility estimators, feature engineering, predictors of post-serving contexts, auxiliary losses, optimizers and hyperparameters may change.

Transforms computed from legally revealed inputs and public problem structure are valid methods, including nonlinear features; the supplied linear RCDP-UCB learner is not a required candidate architecture. Estimating utility parameters from released feedback is permitted.

When retaining the supplied RCDP-UCB pipeline, changing only lambda_reg=1.0, alpha=0.1, C=25, Lambda=10000, mu_tau=100, kappa=0.25, the mapping Adam lr=1e-3 or the mapping epochs=2 does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Minimize cumulative dueling regret in the fixed contextual utility environment with delayed corrupted preferences and the original pre/post-serving feedback order.
The original T2000/d10/e20/K10 contexts and utility law, sinusoidal environment feature mapping, private parameter draws, Gaussian delay process and corruption budget25 remain fixed.

get_context reveals current pre-serving contexts; serve commits the arm pair and returns selected post-serving contexts; advance reveals only due delayed feedback. The10+10 episode split, independent fresh state and mean cumulative regret remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not substitute an easier utility law, context distribution, uncorrupted/instantaneous feedback channel or different regret definition.

Do not obtain true utility coefficients through private seed/state lookup, access unreleased outcomes/future contexts, query the service early, forge actions/regret or carry evaluation-fitted state between episodes.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
Replacing the learned post-serving map with its generating closed form `y=[cos(x), sin(x)]` does not count as a method improvement, even though structural transforms are otherwise allowed.

evidence.finding: Defines frozen sinusoidal contexts, linear true utilities, delay/corruption generation and half-sum regret; true environment is separate from any fitted candidate model.
Public client exposes only the causal service calls, not private closure state.
Trusted trajectories and original hidden utilities determine score; reported regret is independently checked.
Learner uses pre/post-serving contexts and delayed corrupted preferences to minimize regret; actual environment is the fixed research problem.

validation_policy.instance_roles: Preserve explicit per-instance observation/training/calibration/causal-feedback roles; no evaluation-target fitting or validation-derived fitted state carried across independent cases.
validation_policy.enforcement: binding prompt and task contract; task-specific replay/guards where available; arbitrary training-data provenance requires source/patch audit
